title: agent-crew progress event row
description: Per-line shape of {TASK_DIR}/progress.buffer.jsonl (Phase F5). The buffer file is JSON-Lines: each line is one JSON object matching this schema. Validators in F4 inspect this schema per row; consumers per the F5 doc tolerate unknown fields and skip malformed lines.

ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC with seconds precision and trailing Z.

session_id.description: Required at write time but absence-tolerant on read (older buffers may omit).

event.description: One of the events documented in core/agents/supervisor.md Event catalog. Validators do NOT enforce the enum (the vocabulary is additive across phases); they only check non-empty string.
